doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Chick Carter, the singing and dancing bandleader
summary: Chick Carter did not play but sang, danced and conducted like Cab Calloway; the band was small with three trumpets.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: So, we got up to, so let‘s talk about Chick Carter. That was your, that was the first band outside of your family band.
Chick Carter didn‘t play. Chick Carter was, he sang and danced and did things like that, and he was a good-looking cat.
So he kind of like Cab Calloway kind of guy.
Yeah, exactly! I‘m glad you hit that nail on the head. [clears his throat] Excuse me.
But he, he didn‘t do, but he was like Cab Calloway in other words. He conducted the band and he was the handsome cat and all the women was after him like that was after Cab and them kind of thing.
So, Chick Carter band, how big was the band?

Well, it was a big band, but it wasn‘t that big back in them days. He had three trumpets, I think he had maybe four or five, I don‘t know if he had five saxophones or not, ‗cause five saxophones came later in big bands. And more than three trumpets, there was three trumpets in that band. A lot of the time there wasn‘t but two trumpets. But three trumpets, we talking about…
